+def quota_intervals(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    eligible = [j for j in jobs if j["id"] not in blocked]
+    if not mandatory.issubset({j["id"] for j in eligible}):
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    for subset in combinations(eligible, k):
+        ids = tuple(sorted(j["id"] for j in subset))
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        # Half-open intervals: intervals ending at t do not overlap those starting at t.
+        points = sorted({j["start"] for j in subset} | {j["end"] for j in subset})
+        if any(sum(j["start"] <= t < j["end"] for j in subset) > 2 for t in points):
+            continue
+        value = sum(j["value"] for j in subset)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and ids > best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
+

+def temporal_routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    start_node = data["source"]
+    start_mask = bit.get(start_node, 0)
+    start_time = data["start"]
+    initial = (start_node, start_mask, data["coupons"])
+    dist = {initial: start_time}
+    queue = [(start_time, start_node, start_mask, data["coupons"])]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, coupons = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, coupons)
+        if dist.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            dest = edge["v"]
+            next_mask = mask | bit.get(dest, 0)
+            durations = [(edge["duration"], coupons)]
+            if coupons:
+                durations.append((max(1, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0)), coupons - 1))
+            for duration, remaining in durations:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                nxt = (dest, next_mask, remaining)
+                if arrival < dist.get(nxt, float("inf")):
+                    dist[nxt] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, dest, next_mask, remaining))
+    return {"arrival": None}
